title: Italian-Style Tofu Tagine
description: A fusion of Italian and North African flavors, this dish combines crispy tofu with a rich and spicy tagine sauce. Serve with crusty bread for a satisfying meal.
instructions: 2. Cut the tofu into small cubes and coat with a mixture of olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
3. Bake the tofu in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until crispy.
4. In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
5. Add the Berber spice blend and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
6. Add the white wine and cook until reduced by half.
7. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
8. Add the chopped tomatoes and cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
9. Add the baked tofu to the skillet and toss to coat with the tagine sauce.
10. Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
